title: A new start and an old attachment

captions.energy: End what has run its course

meaning: Your union may want to make room for something new while feeling strongly attached to a familiar outcome or way of living.
text: In this energy field, your shared rhythm of change can be complicated: action matures slowly while feelings hold firmly. In the physical position, the High Priestess helps you observe and notice when an old arrangement no longer fits your life. In energy, Death encourages you to bring what is exhausted to a close, releasing effort for another phase. In emotions, the Devil describes an attachment that limits freedom. Even a welcome change can touch something difficult to surrender. An inward sense of being unable to let go does not establish that the old form must remain.

For example, you decide against hosting a large celebration that has become burdensome. As the date approaches, however, you increasingly want its familiar scale back. Without it, your special place among those close to you seems threatened. The freeing decision gathers obligations again. **Starting differently is hard when releasing a habit also means releasing an attractive image of yourselves together.** Distinguishing the value of meeting from attachment to its scale makes the knot easier to understand.

The difficulty may appear as alternating abrupt refusals and returns. Tired of the constraining arrangement, you cancel it completely, then restore everything because you miss feeling significant. New ways of sharing life get little space. Renewal starts serving the old attachment. Acknowledging loss need not require immediately reversing your choice.
